answer: The keystone here is Licensed atlasmaker folio manifest sworn before the chamber court, which costs an honest agent 4-year field service, 189 supervised bindings, geodetic exam, annual re-licensing and a farm a hundred times over. One agent, one proof, 116 POA. 654 agents, 654 proofs, 75864 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. One anchor per identity, one fable per alias, one velvet per epoch: the farm must supply all three, every time. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
